title: Eisenhower warns us of the military industrial complex.
summary: A three-minute clip of Dwight D. Eisenhower's farewell address of January 17, 1961. In it he warns of the unwarranted influence of the military-industrial complex.
why: Cited as a reference whenever threads turn to the NSA, drones, defense contractors or whistleblowers.

quote.text: Only an alert and knowledgeable citizenry can compel the proper meshing of the huge industrial and military machinery of defense
